items.stem: Which statement best describes data mesh?

options.text: An organisational and architectural approach of domain-owned data products with federated governance
options.rationale: Correct: data mesh is a socio-technical approach, not a product.

options.text: A specific software product you purchase and install
options.rationale: Data mesh is an approach, not a single tool.

options.text: A requirement to abandon all governance
options.rationale: It uses federated governance, not none.

options.text: A synonym for a data warehouse
options.rationale: It differs fundamentally from a centralised warehouse model.

items.explanation: Correct: data mesh is a socio-technical approach, not a product.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO characterise a good data product in a mesh? (Select TWO.)

options.text: It is discoverable with documented metadata and a clear interface
options.rationale: Correct: discoverability and clear interfaces are core traits.

options.text: It publishes a service-level agreement for quality and availability
options.rationale: Correct: an SLA sets expectations consumers can rely on.

options.text: It is a raw dump with no owner or documentation
options.rationale: A raw, unowned dump is not a data product.

options.text: It is accessible only to the team that created it
options.rationale: Data products are meant to be shared and consumable.

items.explanation: Correct: discoverability and clear interfaces are core traits.

items.stem: Does federated computational governance mean each domain ignores global rules?

options.text: No; global standards are agreed and automated, while domains own their data
options.rationale: Correct: federated governance balances global standards with local ownership.

options.text: Yes; domains follow no shared standards
options.rationale: Federated governance keeps shared standards in place.

options.text: Yes; a central team dictates every decision
options.rationale: That is the centralised model mesh moves away from.

options.text: It means there is no governance at all

items.explanation: Correct: federated governance balances global standards with local ownership.
